title: Population census of the Netherlands, 1830
descriptions: The dataset is based on the population census of the Netherlands of 1830 published in an almanac of 1831. Content: images of the publication, excel files with data entered from the published tables and a searcheable pdf file of the text sections. Other two sources published in the 19th century have been used to extract census data of 1830.
